title: 5W1H+Which: Context-Valid Semantic Indexing with Progressive Ontology Binding
abstract: arXiv:2609.35184v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Semantic indexing must preserve reusable source information without committing too early to one business schema, while providing checkable premises for reasoning. We propose 5W1H+Which, a design that separates source-grounded content extraction from progressive ontology binding. The 5W1H questions organize independently addressable content units; Which records links to versioned ontology elements, mapping relations, applicability scopes, and validation states. Time, location, system environment, and participant roles constrain when facts, bindings, and rules may be used. Unbound content remains searchable, whereas formal reasoning requires explicit premise checks. The design distinguishes business valid time, system knowledge time, and operational traces, and tracks dependencies for revalidation and incremental maintenance. translated_title: 5W1H+Which：基于渐进式本体绑定的上下文有效语义索引
translated_abstract: 语义索引必须在不过早绑定到某一业务模式的前提下保留可复用的源信息，同时为推理提供可检验的前提。我们提出5W1H+Which，这是一种将基于源的内容提取与渐进式本体绑定相分离的设计。5W1H问题用于组织可独立寻址的内容单元；Which则记录与版本化本体元素的链接、映射关系、适用范围和验证状态。时间、位置、系统环境和参与者角色约束了事实、绑定和规则的使用时机。未绑定的内容仍然保持可搜索性，而形式化推理则需要显式的前提检查。该设计区分了业务有效时间、系统知识时间和操作轨迹，并跟踪依赖关系以支持重新验证和增量维护。工作实例展示了云迁移和时间性策略有效性等应用场景。所得到的链接语料库可以支持……
tldr: 论文提出5W1H+Which设计，通过将基于源的内容提取与渐进式本体绑定相分离，实现了既保留可复用信息、又为推理提供可检验前提的上下文有效语义索引。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes 5W1H+Which, a design that separates source-grounded content extraction from progressive ontology binding, enabling context-valid semantic indexing that preserves reusable information while providing checkable premises for reasoning.
